title: Geonormal dim one smooth
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $Z$ a finite type $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with $\dim Z\le1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Suppose $Z$ is geometrically normal: every local ring of $Z_L=Z\times_k\operatorname{Spec}L$ is an integrally closed domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-pc-fibre-product] for every field extension $L/k$. Then $Z$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and geometrically reduced over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. Moreover, for any field extension $L/k$, if $Z_L$ is connected and nonempty [def-weil-connected-scheme], then $Z_L$ is irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].

proof.text: Fix a field extension L/k and write Y = Z_L. The second pullback projection is locally of finite type over Spec L, since this property is stable under base change. LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian therefore makes Y locally Noetherian. This is the local part of lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian; no global compactness argument is needed.

The existing source-library theorem topologicalKrullDim_pullback_eq_of_field, already audited as a closed declaration of lem-pc-dim-base-change, gives dim(Y) = dim(Z). Thus dim(Y) is at most one. Apply IsRegular.of_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk (lem-sc-normal-dim1-dvr) to hnormal L and this dimension bound. It packages the field/DVR argument, including the stalk dimension comparison, and proves that Y is regular. This argument applies to every field extension, including the empty scheme case.

For every finitely generated field extension L/k, step 2 supplies regularity of all stalks of Z_L. Apply smooth_iff_regularLocalRing_finitelyGenerated_field_baseChange in the reverse direction to obtain smoothness of Z over k. No perfectness of k is required.

For each extension L/k and each x in Z_L, the domain part of hnormal L x gives a reduced stalk. Apply isReduced_of_isReduced_stalk to obtain reducedness of Z_L. The commutative-ring specialization of geometrically_isReduced identifies this quantified condition with GeometricallyReduced of the structure morphism.

If Z_L is connected and nonempty, use its local Noetherianity from step 1 and regularity from step 2. IsRegular.isIntegral (lem-sc-regular-connected-integral) makes it integral, and the integral-scheme irreducibility instance yields IrreducibleSpace Z_L. ConnectedSpace includes nonemptiness, so the empty case never satisfies this antecedent.
